description: A catalog of publicly available prompt injection, jailbreak, AI agent security, tool abuse, RAG security, browser agent security, and LLM red teaming datasets.

datasets.name: JailbreakBench
datasets.citation: Chao et al., 'JailbreakBench: An Open Robustness Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Language Models', 2024
datasets.limitations: Focuses primarily on single-turn text jailbreaks; small sample count of highly refined attacks.

datasets.name: AdvBench (LLM-Attacks)
datasets.citation: Zou et al., 'Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Language Models', 2023
datasets.limitations: Tokens generated via GCG can be easily filtered by basic perplexity checks; static dataset.

datasets.name: Anthropic Red Teaming Dataset
datasets.citation: Ganguli et al., 'Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned', 2022
datasets.limitations: Focuses heavily on human-generated text attempts; lacks modern tool-use or agentic vectors.

datasets.name: AgentDojo (Agent Attack Benchmark)
datasets.citation: Liao et al., 'AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment for Assessing Autonomous Agent Security', 2024
datasets.limitations: Requires a runtime environment to evaluate; complex to set up compared to static CSVs.

datasets.name: HackAPrompt Dataset
datasets.citation: Schulhoff et al., 'Ignore This Title and HackAPrompt: Exposing Systemic Vulnerabilities of Large Language Models through a Global Prompt Hacking Competition', 2023
datasets.limitations: Highly skewed towards single-turn prompt leakage and simple instruction overrides.

datasets.name: PromptInject
datasets.citation: Perez & Ribeiro, 'Ignore Previous Prompt: Attack Vectors for Robustness in Natural Language Processing', 2022
datasets.limitations: Template-based synthetic dataset; lacks sophisticated obfuscation and multi-turn realism.

datasets.name: ToxicChat
datasets.citation: Lin et al., 'ToxicChat: Unveiling Hidden Challenges of Toxicity Detection in Real-World User-AI Conversation', 2023
datasets.limitations: Focused primarily on identifying toxicity rather than complex prompt injection chains.

datasets.name: BeaverTails
datasets.citation: Ji et al., 'BeaverTails: Towards Improved Safety Alignment of LLM via a Human-Preference Dataset', 2023
datasets.limitations: Contains pairs of helpful vs harmful responses for RLHF, not necessarily complex evasion techniques.

datasets.name: Do-Not-Answer
datasets.citation: Wang et al., 'Do-Not-Answer: A Dataset for Evaluating Safeguards in LLMs', 2023
datasets.limitations: Relatively small dataset, designed for benchmarking rather than training.

datasets.name: WildTeaming
datasets.citation: Li et al., 'WildTeaming at Scale: From In-the-Wild Jailbreaks to (Adversarially) Safer Language Models', 2024
datasets.limitations: Synthesized and filtered from wild telemetry, which can introduce artifacts and format biases.

datasets.name: XSTest
datasets.citation: Röttger et al., 'XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models', 2023
datasets.limitations: Tests for false positives in safety guardrails, not an attack dataset itself.

datasets.name: SPML (Semantic Prompt Injection for Machine Learning)
datasets.limitations: Small scope focused specifically on semantic injection variants.

datasets.name: PoisonedRAG
datasets.citation: Zou et al., 'PoisonedRAG: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks to Retrieval-Augmented Generation of Large Language Models', 2024
datasets.limitations: Focused purely on retrieval collision and corpus poisoning; does not cover multi-modal RAG.

datasets.name: TensorTrust (DEF CON AI Village CTF)
datasets.citation: Toyer et al., 'TensorTrust: Interpretable Prompt Injection Attacks from an Online Game', 2023
datasets.limitations: Gameified dataset with highly constrained challenge environments; may not generalize to full agents.

datasets.name: SafetyBench
datasets.citation: Zhang et al., 'SafetyBench: Evaluating the Safety of Large Language Models with Multiple Choice Questions', 2023
datasets.limitations: Multiple-choice evaluation format limits real-world open-ended prompt injection relevance.

datasets.name: TrustLLM
datasets.citation: Sun et al., 'TrustLLM: Trustworthiness in Large Language Models', 2024
datasets.limitations: A meta-benchmark evaluating overall trustworthiness rather than specific deep exploitation vectors.
